plan.line: a passive buzzer module that beeps and plays tones and simple melodies, one note at a time (best between 1000 and 5000 Hz). It can't play recorded sound, music files or speech.

code.pinLine: passive buzzer {ref} on {gpio}, which is ON while the pin is LOW: start the program with Pin({g}, Pin.OUT, value=1) so it is quiet. To play a note: pwm = PWM(Pin({g})), pwm.freq(440), pwm.duty_u16(32768). To stop: pwm.deinit(), then Pin({g}, Pin.OUT, value=1) (HIGH = off). Never pwm.duty_u16(0): that holds the pin LOW and keeps this buzzer switched on. Notes in Hz: C4 262, D4 294, E4 330, F4 349, G4 392, A4 440, B4 494, C5 523; it sounds loudest between 1000 and 5000 Hz.
handoff: | {gpio} | {phys} | {refs} | {mode} | `PWM(Pin({g}))  (freq(f), duty_u16(32768); stop: deinit() + Pin({g}, Pin.OUT, value=1))` |
